name: Not24Get
description: Save the current tab to your not24get.me workspace. Sends page URL, title, notes, and tags to app.not24get.me when you sign in and click Save. After Save, the extension captures a screenshot of the visible tab. On plans that include full-text search, it also sends the readable page text so the server does not need to fetch the page again. Optional bookmark import/export uses the bookmarks permission only when you choose those actions.
